# KPI Tree / Metric Hierarchy (Willy Su)

**Member 3 — KPI Tree**

The proposed North Star KPI is **Qualified Consultation Leads**: consultation inquiries that meet the practice's agreed qualification criteria. Because these criteria and the availability of lead-status data have not yet been confirmed, **Consultation Inquiries** (successfully submitted consultation requests) are the interim measurable proxy. This is a proposed measurement framework, not a claim about current client performance.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    NS["North Star: Qualified Consultation Leads<br/>(interim proxy: Consultation Inquiries)"]
    A["Acquisition"]
    E["Engagement"]
    C["Conversion Funnel"]
    Q["Lead Quality"]
    NS --- A
    NS --- E
    NS --- C
    NS --- Q
    A --> A1["Users"]
    A --> A2["Sessions"]
    A --> A3["Organic Search Sessions"]
    E --> E1["Engaged Sessions"]
    E --> E2["Service Page Views"]
    E --> E3["Consultation CTA Clicks"]
    C --> C1["Consultation Form Starts"]
    C --> C2["Successful Form Submissions"]
    C --> C3["Form Completion Rate"]
    Q --> Q1["Inquiries in Service Area"]
    Q --> Q2["Inquiries by Service Interest"]
    Q --> Q3["Validated / Qualified Inquiries"]
```

**Metric definitions and measurement notes**

| Driver | Metrics and operational definitions |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Acquisition | **Users:** distinct GA4 users during the reporting period; **Sessions:** GA4 sessions; **Organic Search Sessions:** sessions attributed to the Organic Search channel. |
| Engagement | **Engaged Sessions:** GA4 sessions meeting its engagement criteria; **Service Page Views:** `page_view` events on identified service pages; **Consultation CTA Clicks:** clicks on designated consultation calls to action (custom tracking may be needed). |
| Conversion Funnel | **Consultation Form Starts:** tracked starts of the consultation form; **Successful Form Submissions:** confirmed successful consultation form submissions, excluding duplicates; **Form Completion Rate:** successful submissions ÷ form starts × 100%, with event counting and deduplication rules agreed in advance. |
| Lead Quality | **Inquiries in Service Area:** inquiries with confirmed geography inside the agreed service area; **Inquiries by Service Interest:** inquiries categorized by requested orthodontic service; **Validated / Qualified Inquiries:** inquiries that meet client-approved qualification rules, if CRM or follow-up data are accessible. |

**Diagnostic cuts:** Analyze the above metrics, where available and appropriate, by **default channel group / source-medium, campaign, landing page, device category, and geography**. Break down service-related and lead-quality metrics by **service interest** when captured. Avoid treating unknown geography or missing lead status as confirmed disqualification.

**Dependencies and assumptions:** Member 2 should confirm the KPI definitions and decision questions; Member 4 should map the needed events and parameters; Member 5 should test collection. Lead qualification requires client-defined criteria and potentially CRM integration. Form starts, CTA clicks, and service interest may require additional GTM/GA4 configuration. GA4 alone cannot establish whether an inquiry is qualified without supporting data.
